# Jakob Paludan

Jakob Paludan is named in the ADHD-databasen documentation as Lægefaglig direktør (medical director) for Psykiatrien Region Midtjylland [^src1]. In the steering group ("styregruppen") for the ADHD database, he represents the Regionssundhedsdirektørkredsen, the network of regional health directors across Denmark's five regions [^src1]. His inclusion places him among the steering group members drawn from all five Danish regions, professional societies, patient organizations, and the Danish Healthcare Quality Programme (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut), who together oversee data on ADHD assessment and treatment pathways for children, young people, and adults over the period 1 April 2024 – 31 March 2025 [^src1]. Through this role, Jakob Paludan is professionally linked to [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], where he serves as medical director of the psychiatric services [^src1].

No further biographical details, claims, or timeline events involving Jakob Paludan are present in the corpus.
